CR1.label: Access / QR code

CR1.1.label: Already redeemed
CR1.1.description: The code was already redeemed, and the customer is trying to redeem it again.

CR1.2.label: Invalid
CR1.2.description: The code does not work as entered, there is uncertainty around format, dashes, copied code, or where to redeem it. It could be set up wrong.

CR1.3.label: Missing
CR1.3.description: The customer expected a code but cannot find it, including a second reveal/resource code linked to an eBook or resources. It is usually seen for an ebook purchase outside of evolve (eg. kindle / amazon)

CR1.4.label: Lack of user guidance
CR1.4.description: The customer does not understand where to find the access code, where to redeem the code, what the code unlocks, or why it does not give access to the expected content. Additionnaly, the product might not be included in a bundle.

CR1.5.label: Book entitlement misunderstanding
CR1.5.description: The customer has a code from a physical book and expects it to unlock more than it actually does, such as a full eBook instead of complementary resources. Sometimes, the customer expects to receive ebook access

CR1.6.label: Damaged
CR1.6.description: The customer code on a physical resource is damaged and/or unusable. Code would be described as scratched off, unreadable, torn, not clear, illegible, defective

CR1.7.label: Not enough info
CR1.7.description: The ticket mentions an access code, but the transcript or extract does not show enough resolution to identify the cause.

CR1.8.label: Other
CR1.8.description: Use only when the issue is clearly code-related but none of the transcript-supported root causes fit.

CR1.description: Use when the customer reaches out because an access code or QR/access code seems to be the issue: redeeming it, entering it, reusing it, missing it, etc. The agent would confirm that this is an access code issue.

CR2.label: Login / password

CR2.1.label: Email or passcode not received
CR2.1.description: The customer did not receive a reset or verification email or code, one-time login passcode, or magic link, often because the email is wrong or no longer accessible. Sometimes they didn't checked their spams.

CR2.2.label: Wrong email
CR2.2.description: The customer was using an email that is not the one associated with the account.

CR2.3.label: Password reset needed
CR2.3.description: The password is incorrect and the likely resolution is a password reset.

CR2.4.label: Not enough info
CR2.4.description: The login issue is visible, but the transcript does not confirm whether the cause is wrong email, missing passcode, reset needed, or something else.

CR2.5.label: Other
CR2.5.description: Use only for a confirmed login/password issue that does not fit the transcript-supported root causes.

CR2.description: Use when the customer cannot log in because of password, reset email, passcode, magic link, wrong email, verification email issue, etc.

CR3.label: Account

CR3.1.label: Duplicate accounts
CR3.1.description: The customer has multiple accounts, causing missing access, mismatched content, or confusion.

CR3.2.label: Update email / Account update
CR3.2.description: The customer needs their account email or account details updated, often because the old email is wrong or no longer accessible. They could also need their account settings updated

CR3.3.label: Not enough info
CR3.3.description: There is likely an account issue, but the resolution is missing or unclear.

CR3.4.label: Wrong user role setup
CR3.4.description: The customer is usually a faculty member who claims to have registered as a student or vice versa (and want their account changed to faculty)

CR3.5.label: Email / phone already in use
CR3.5.description: The customer is trying to access Evolve but are told that their email / phone is already in use.

CR3.6.label: No institution associated
CR3.6.description:
The customer is not able to see the institution that they are in listed in the options, institution is missing, they can't complete the process.
There are cases where the customer is not affiliated with institution so they wouldn't need it

CR3.7.label: Other
CR3.7.description: Use only for a confirmed account issue that does not fit the transcript-supported root causes.

CR3.description: Use when the issue is driven by account identity or account setup: old vs new account, account merge, duplicate accounts, or email/account mismatch across systems.

CR4.label: Course Access

CR4.1.label: Lack of user guidance
CR4.1.description: The customer is confused about what course, product, package, edition, or material they should access. The customer could aso be confused about the difference between an access code, a course ID, and what each one gives access to.

CR4.2.label: Not enough info
CR4.2.description: The customer says they cannot access something in a course, but the conversation stops before the cause is confirmed.

CR4.3.label: Browser / Device
CR4.3.description: The customer cannot access a course due to a browser or device configuration issue.

CR4.4.label: Invalid course ID
CR4.4.description: The customer entered their cours ID wrong, ot it doesn't exist, or it's incomplete

CR4.5.label: Faculty enrollment
CR4.5.description: Request from a faculty trying to enroll their co-faculty to a course

CR4.6.label: Other
CR4.6.description: Use for a confirmed course access issue that does not fit the more specific course root causes.

CR4.description: Use only when the customer cannot access, enter, enroll in, or reach a course or course content. This doesn't cover an issue related to a course feature.

CR5.label: eBook & other stores

CR5.1.label: Ebook entitlement misunderstanding
CR5.1.description: The customer thinks an eBook, EAQ, or other digital item is included, but the checked package/access code inclusion shows it is not. Could be an eBook entitlement misunderstanding or an ebook resource confusion, such as expecting the full eBook when they only have resources, or expecting resources with an eBook

CR5.2.label: No VST account setup
CR5.2.description: The customer cannot access the eBook because the VitalSource account is not set up or they are not using the correct VST flow. The customer was prompted to verify their email and they can't vierfy (mispelled email / wrong email). Sometimes, the agent would confirm they needed to merge customers bookshelf vital source account, agent refered to contact vitalsource support to merge account

CR5.3.label: Information request
CR5.3.description: The customer is asking for information about eBook access, such as duration or expiration, and nothing is actually broken.

CR5.4.label: Lack of user guidance
CR5.4.description: The customer needs guidance on where or how to access the eBook, or navigation guidance on where to find the ebook

CR5.5.label: Not enough info
CR5.5.description: The eBook issue is visible, but the transcript does not confirm whether it is entitlement, VST setup, information request, or guidance.

CR5.6.label: Other
CR5.6.description: Use for a confirmed eBook/VST/other-store issue that does not fit the specific root causes.

CR5.description: Use when the issue is about eBook access, VitalSource, other-store/bookstore purchase, eBook access duration, or confusion between eBook and resources. Customer can also be trying to download vitalsource bookshelf app

CR6.label: Resources

CR6.1.label: Lack of user guidance
CR6.1.description: The resources exist, but the customer is looking in the wrong place, selecting the wrong edition, or misunderstanding what resources they have.

CR6.2.label: Browser / Device
CR6.2.description: The customer cannot access a resource due to a browser or device configuration issue.

CR6.3.label: Resource-product association issue
CR6.3.description: The customer is facing a set-up issue (e.g missing, wrong edition, etc.)

CR6.4.label: Other
CR6.4.description: Use for a confirmed resource access issue that does not fit guidance, browser/device, or proven product association.

CR6.5.label: Not enough info
CR6.5.description: The customer reports a resources issue but the transcript lacks enough resolution to identify the cause.

CR6.description: Use when the customer cannot find or access resources they believe they bought or should have with a product/book/course.

CR7.label: Product request

CR7.1.label: Other
CR7.1.description: Use for a simple product/book information request when no more specific product-request root cause exists.

CR7.2.label: Faculty ebook request follow-up
CR7.2.description: customer already placed an order previsouly for ebook / print and is following up on the status of the request. It could be an adoption request, complementary or desk copy request.

CR7.3.label: Ebook access request
CR7.3.description: didn't request the ebook yet but not sure they've already placed a request, would ask to add the ebook on their account / place the request on their behalf - want a digital version of the book

CR7.4.label: Faculty resources request follow-up
CR7.4.description: customer already placed an order previsouly for resources and is following up on the status of the request

CR7.5.label: Author request
CR7.5.description: Elsevier's employees requesting access for digital products or requesting digital product access for an author / for SME / for a reviewer

CR7.6.label: Lack of user guidance
CR7.6.description:
Users are not not onboarded really well / training.
Instructors redeemed the access code from their book instead of requesting access to resources

CR7.description: Use when the customer is asking about a product or book, without an actual access failure.

CR8.label: Other access related

CR8.1.label: Other
CR8.1.description: Use when the issue is access-related, the root cause is identifiable but not provided in the list.

CR8.2.label: Not enough info
CR8.2.description: The issue is access-related, but the transcript does not provide enough detail to identify a more specific root cause.

CR8.description: Use when there is a real access issue, but it does not fit the more specific access categories.

CR9.label: Other not access related

CR9.1.label: Other
CR9.1.description: Use for a non-access feature, content, workflow, or functionality issue when no more specific root cause exists.

CR9.2.label: Content in a product
CR9.2.description: The customer is reporting a content error. For example, answer to a question is incorrect / content shows incorrect info / mispelling or miscalculation / content shows "coming soon"

CR9.3.label: No root cause
CR9.3.description: Acceptable when the group decides the case is not access related and no root cause needs to be forced.

CR9.description: Use when the customer already has access and the problem is about feature behavior, content, notifications, submissions, video playback, or another non-access workflow.

CR10.label: Non Evolve

CR10.1.label: Non Evolve
CR10.1.description: The customer contacted Evolve support, but the actual issue belongs to another product or support path.

CR10.description: Use when the issue belongs to another product or support flow, such as HESI, Shadow Health, Adaptive Quizzing, or SurePath.

CR11.label: Trial

CR11.2.label: Trial extension request
CR11.2.description: The customer is asking extension with their trials / can't pay for full access yet, need a day or two to complete the assignement

CR11.3.label: Trial setup / availability issue
CR11.3.description: The customer is trying to get multiple trials / can't see a trial options for 14 days free trials

CR11.4.label: Other
CR11.4.description: Use when the issue is trial-related, the root cause is identifiable but not provided in the list.

CR11.5.label: Not enough info
CR11.5.description: The issue is access-related, but the transcript does not provide enough detail to identify a more specific root cause.

CR11.description: Use only when the issue is genuinely trial-specific.
